facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's press release, AdExchanger's Top 50 Programmatic Power Players list is described as a definitive list of the top agencies and strategic partners in digital advertising.
facts.quote: The Top 50 Programmatic Power Players list is a definitive list of the top agencies and strategic partners in the digital advertising industry.

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes itself as used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is a self-serve programmatic advertising platform used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.

facts.fact: According to AdExchanger editors as described in the release, Power Players entries were evaluated on quality and scope of offerings and demonstrated case studies, selected from a vast pool of global submissions.
facts.quote: AdExchanger selected the companies for the Programmatic Power Players list from a vast pool of global submissions.
